topic.title: Dynamic Tables
topic.shortdesc: Documentation and examples for creating dynamic tables with the Bootstrap Table extension.

body.p: The DITA Bootstrap Table plug-in is a DITA-OT plug-in that incorporates the Bootstrap Table library and adds the necessary CSS and JavaScript for dynamic tables with search, sort, and pagination functions.
body.note: If you just want to style DITA tables with the standard Bootstrap table styles, you don’t need a separate plug-in. See for details on the output classes that the DITA Bootstrap plug-in supports.

section.title: Installing the DITA Bootstrap Table plug-in
section.p: Use the dita command to add the DITA Bootstrap Table plug-in to your DITA Open Toolkit installation:

section.title: Search and Filtering
section.p: Add table otherprops="search" to filter the results based on a search term.

fig.title: Example table with the results filtering on "Bear"

section.title: Pagination
section.p: Add table otherprops="pagination" to add a pagination footer to a large table.

fig.title: Paginated table with 140 rows reduced to ten

section.title: Sorting
section.p: Add table otherprops="sortable" to allow each column to be sorted dynamically.

fig.title: Sorted table using reverse alphabetical order
